title: Zaamin hai Imame Reza
body:
Zaamin hai Imame Reza
Ya sayyadi ya maulayi
Ya imam e reza
Ae ehle aza fi amanir-reza..(2)
mash'had se sada dete hai ye imam e reza..ae ehle aza
bazu pe agar baandh lo taweez e reza
zamin hai imam e reza..(3)
1. Ye rasm nahi qaul hai ye (maula reza ka)..(2)
sikka nahi taweez hai ye (radde bala ka)..(2)
mushkil hi nahi raah se tal jae qaza..ae ehle aza
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Maa behno ko bacho ko (pehnao ye sikka)..(2) aur malise shabbir me (batwao ye sikka)..(2)
banjaoge batil ke liye behre khuda..ae ehle aza
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hoga na koi khauf (balao ka kabhi bhi)..(2)
tootega yazeedo ka bharam (dekhna khudhi)..(2)
khud maut pilaegi tumhe aabe baqa..ae ehle aza
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Taweez e reza ho ya (alamdaar ka parcham)..(2)
dono hi mita dete hai (taqdeer ke sab ghum)..(2)
ghaazi ka alam dega tumhe khud hi dua..ae ehle aza
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Taboot uthe jab bhi kahi (maula reza ka)..(2)
taboot se taweez (dua karke uthana)..(2)
jo mangoge us waqt tumhe dega khuda.. ae ehle aza
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Har daur me har nasl me (raej ho ye sikka)..(2)
jo nasl abhi aengi (uska ho ye wirsa)..(2)
khatoone qayamat bhi tumhe dengi dua..ae ehle aza
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Dete raho pursa, mazloom raza ka
masooma e qum bhi talabgaar hai
zakhmi hai kaleja, kuch to ho dilasa
wo bibi abhi tak dilafgaar hai
us dil ko isi tarha suku aaega..ae ehle aza
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ek farsh bichao, logo ko bulao aur padhke masaeb karo ye buka
jab zehre sitam ne, dil kar diya tukde
duniya se sidhara wo maula mera
tukdo me bata qalb simat jaega..ae ehle aza
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Haan mazhar o irfaan, karte raho aelaan
duniya ko batao haqeeqat hai kya
darain ke sardaar, hai maliko mukhtaar
maula mere sarkaar imam e reza
tum inke zamanat me rahoge sadaa..ae ehle aza
